items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: We played and had these jam sessions with Mary Lou Williams and with the great Duke Ellington's orchestra.

ctx.x: Tony Williams was a guest. There was another drummer there, I can't remember now, But you were there and it was a glorious three days. We played and had these jam sessions with Mary Lou Williams and with the great Duke Ellington's orchestra. You want to say something about that, Jo?

The young man was there, naturally, Mr. Eubie Blake and his partner Mr. Noble Sissle. However, they elected me to take care of Eubie Blake, Duke Ellington, and what have you. They told me that I had to take the children into hand. You remember all the bass players was there - Charlie Mingus, George Duvivier, Ray Brown, Sam Stewart... all you guys were there. But they turned it over to me, says, "Will you take care of these little teenagers." And I was trying to make like I was 22 years old. What happened was that…
